description: Versioned provisional defaults referenced by D1 FR-01 to FR-05. These are design defaults for requirement review and static validation, not approved business policy and not application implementation.

execution_policy_v1.adapter_retry_rule: adapter-internal retries must be disabled or counted against the same budget
execution_policy_v1.http_count_rule: count at the actual outbound request boundary; includes retries and redirects; cache hits and local short-circuits are 0

rules.default_equivalence: explicit defaults and omitted defaults are equivalent only after parsing to the same semantic value
rules.object_order: object key order never changes identity
rules.list_order: list order is normalized only when the method declares it non-semantic
rules.instrument_aliases: aliases may share identity only within the same canonical market; cross-market aliases never merge
rules.unknown_parameters: reject before vendor call; never silently drop
rules.window_boundary: inclusive start and end after resolution in run_clock.timezone
rules.secret_material: raw credentials never enter a persisted key; a non-secret configured identity digest may be used

coverage_profile_v1.period_slot_rule: each declared annual or quarter slot requires at least one qualifying evidence item; one item cannot fill two slots; no single-quarter derivation by subtraction; no TTM extension

current_date_rules.ticker_news: critical when the news analyst is enabled
current_date_rules.social_sentiment: critical when the social analyst is enabled; requires stocktwits and reddit with min_successful_components=1; sentiment_news is optional context

coverage_profile_v1.override_rule: an override may add or remove non-mandatory requirements and record profile_source=override; it cannot remove mandatory market_price, stock financial_statements, historical visibility, or another safety condition

risk_scope_v1.supported_portfolio_scope: single-currency, unlevered cash plus long positions; no short, derivative, leverage, multiple-order, FX, or broker integration
risk_scope_v1.input_numeric_grammar: canonical unsigned decimal string: at most 30 integer digits and at most 12 fractional digits; no exponent, plus sign, whitespace, leading zero (except integer 0), negative zero, or meaningless trailing zeros; zero is exactly 0
risk_scope_v1.comparison: exact cross-multiplication after P>0 and E>0; division only for display with half-up 6dp; equality passes

history_scan_v1.index_rule: optional derived index is rebuildable and non-authoritative; every read revalidates

timing_and_write_evidence_v1.self_reference_rule: a manifest must not contain its own replace completion time or its own serialization-to-fsync duration; those belong to external WriteEvidence

token_accounting_v1.call_identity: call_id deduplicates streaming chunks and repeated callbacks; logical invocation and provider attempt are separate
token_accounting_v1.field_validity: non-negative integer; boolean and negative values invalid

status_rule.complete: every required field valid for every counted call; zero calls is complete with real zeros
status_rule.partial: at least one valid usage field but not complete
status_rule.unavailable: calls > 0 and no valid usage field

token_accounting_v1.partial_rule: known sums of incomplete fields are coverage-qualified contributions, not complete totals and not complete billing evidence

financial_metric_v1.price: latest completed verifiable close at fixed run_clock cutoff; record price_as_of, price_date, source, currency, adjustment basis; no future close; unknown split/FX basis -> n/a
financial_metric_v1.comparability: fiscal position/span plus documented calendar evidence; exact day count not required; no near-date heuristic

brief_budget_v1.reference_rule: resolved, verified, token-measured payload before model call; no resolver -> branch unavailable
